name: Monitor Loupe (Bildschirmlupe)
description: A pointer-following GNOME magnifier (Bildschirmlupe, Bildschirmvergrößerung) for large and multi-monitor desktops. Customize the lens shape, size, frame color and thickness. Includes keyboard shortcuts, adjustable zoom steps and optional scroll-wheel zoom with configurable modifier keys (Ctrl+Super by default). Change the scroll-wheel shortcut and toggle it on or off directly in preferences.
